No. Legis.2‑42/Law/79‑IV,
dated 26‑9‑2001.‑‑‑The following Ordinance made
by the Governor of Balochistan on 18th September, 2001 is hereby published for
general information:
1. Short title and
commencement...(I) This Ordinance may be called he
Balochistan Forest (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001,
(2) It shall come into force on the 14th day of August, 2001.
